## Why visit

A compact, knowledgeable place to explore modern British brewing while retaining a genuine cask option. The small street-level room and basement create an intimate setting, and the bottle shop gives the visit a purpose beyond another round of pale ale: look for bottle-conditioned beer or something unusual to share later. It fits best into a Heaton Chapel approach to Stockport or a separate short outing, rather than a rushed detour midway through the old-town heritage pubs. The attraction is careful selection and a sociable scale, with British and continental choices in addition to local names.

## Beer

The official site advertises two casks and eight keg lines; CAMRA lists three changing beers. Range varies, so do not assume all listed capacity is in use.

## Plan the visit

Small venue; CAMRA lists Monday closure and later opening on several weekdays. Ground-floor access and basement seating may matter.

**Getting there:** Near Heaton Chapel station, separate from the central Stockport walking cluster.

Check [November transport issues](../logistics.md) for date-specific disruption.
